note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is recorded as unknown, only the soldier and worker being described; the original gives only a proportion, not measurements, for the worker postclypeus, so only the proportion is recorded; synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow, antennae pale yellow, mandibles reddish brown. Head rather densely pilose, body densely pilose. Body length 2.83–3.30 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, widest anteriorly (length to mandible base 0.90–1.00 mm, to apex of frontal projection 0.88–1.03 mm, maximum width 0.68–0.78 mm, width/length 0.75–0.85); frontal projection broadly rounded, anterior margin rounded, reaching near the mandible base. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Anterior margin of labrum broadly incurved (length 0.20 mm, width 0.18 mm). Mandibles slender and rod-like, about as long as head (length 0.93–1.00 mm, left mandible length/head length 1.00–1.10). Postmentum rod-like, waist weakly incurved (length 0.35–0.40 mm, maximum width 0.25–0.28 mm, waist width 0.21–0.25 mm). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped (length 0.13–0.18 mm, width 0.30–0.38 mm), anterior margin not notched.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish white to pale yellow, antennae and body paler than head; head and body rather densely pilose. Body length 2.75–3.40 mm. Head capsule subcircular (length to apex of labrum 0.80–0.90 mm, length to mandible base 0.50–0.63 mm, maximum width 0.65–0.70 mm). Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 4 about as long as segment 3 or slightly shorter. Postclypeus inflated, pilose, about half as long as wide. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped (length 0.13–0.15 mm, maximum width 0.33–0.38 mm).
